howItWorks.title: From browsing to export documents
howItWorks.description: B2B workflow that was previously scattered across email, WhatsApp, and spreadsheets — now on one platform.
howItWorks.step1Body: Filter by category, certification, and country of origin. Save favourite products for a shortlist.
howItWorks.step2Body: Select products, enter quantity & UOM, then send Request for Quotation to sellers. Multi-seller at once.
howItWorks.step3Body: Sellers respond with complete quotations (price per UOM, MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Negotiate in a centralised thread.
howItWorks.step4Body: Convert quotation into a Purchase Order. Digital signatures, instalment payment receipts, and all documents stored.
howItWorks.step5Body: Monitor production, packing list, through to Bill of Lading and invoice. Automatic updates at every milestone.

whyChooseUs.title: Built for export B2B
whyChooseUs.description: Not just a product listing. We're a complete export procurement platform.
whyChooseUs.feat1Desc: Every seller goes through KYC verification. You can be confident about who you are dealing with.
whyChooseUs.feat3Desc: PI, PO, BL, packing list, COO, and other export documents in one place.
whyChooseUs.feat4Desc: Track your shipment status from production to delivery.
whyChooseUs.feat5Desc: Send one RFQ to multiple sellers and compare their offers.
whyChooseUs.feat6Desc: Record instalment payments and upload payment proofs per invoice.
whyChooseUs.feat2Desc: Send one request to multiple sellers at once. Save time, get the best option within hours.
whyChooseUs.feat1BodyFull: Every seller must pass KYC: business license, tax ID, and legal documents. No middleman.
whyChooseUs.feat2BodyFull: Send one request to multiple sellers at once. Save time, get the best option within hours.
whyChooseUs.feat3BodyFull: Invoice, packing list, BL, certificate of origin — all stored and linked to one order.
whyChooseUs.feat4BodyFull: Integration with freight forwarders. Track containers from origin port to destination.
whyChooseUs.feat5BodyFull: Production schedule per seller becomes visible. No more guessing when goods are ready.
whyChooseUs.feat6BodyFull: Account manager for active buyers. Help with negotiation, disputes, and escalation if needed.

testimonials.title: Trusted by buyers and suppliers
testimonials.description: Stories from those who have used Indovitri for their export supply chain.
testimonials.quote1: Used to take 3 weeks to source handmade Bali ceramics — now from shortlist to PO in 4 days. Multi-seller RFQ is a real game changer.
testimonials.quote2: As a seller, the production schedule dashboard + KYC verified badge helps us look more credible to overseas buyers. Inquiries up 3x.
testimonials.quote3: Complete shipment tracking from BL to delivery confirmation saves 6 hours per week I used to spend chasing updates on WhatsApp.
